Eligible 304 candidate set and strong/weak/absent-validator selection; supplied metadata, Content-Length/processing exceptions, body ownership and unconditional fallback retained.

Single-user GET cache, accounts/sign-out/redaction, bytes/encoding, bounded LRU/atomic generations, library/custom/live alternatives and retired URL-only history retained. No implementation/audit/witness is fabricated.
